node.title: Re: How to set tty settings from perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Unfortunately after some upgrades, this code now stopped working

That's strange, it doesn't seem like [mod://IO::Stty] ever supported crtscts.

Does anyone have a suggestion on how to to id properly?

Well, if you look at the [https://metacpan.org/release/IO-Stty/source/lib/IO/Stty.pm|source], what the module is doing is mostly tedious, but not too complex. You could set attributes on the port using your own [doc://POSIX]::Termios object.

You might also be interested in my node [id://1183290]; I've been using [mod://IO::Termios] with good success (also in combination with [mod://IO::Stty]).

open(Client,"+>/dev/ttyUSB0") || die "open: $!";

BTW, see [id://11102684].

My fallback solution is to just system() stty...

Yes, in the worst case that's a possibility, I am guessing this code isn't meant to be super portable anyway. I'd recommend using a module instead of plain [doc://system], I showed some examples [id://1180578|here].
